title: (No AI) Google DeepMind’s new AI model can control a robot’s entire body
author: Emma Roth
content:
![An image of Apptronik’s Apollo 2 robot taking a baseball glove off of a shelf](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/07/gemini-robotics-2-shelf.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Apptronik’s Apollo 2 robot takes a baseball glove off of a shelf. | Image: Google

Google DeepMind says the latest version of its Gemini Robotics AI model can "control entire humanoid robots." While the [previous model focused](https://www.theverge.com/news/628021/google-deepmind-gemini-robotics-ai-models) on controlling a humanoid robot's upper body, [Gemini Robotics 2](https://deepmind.google/models/gemini-robotics/vla/) now supports "whole-body motions" ranging from its feet to fingertips, according to an [announcement on Thursday](https://deepmind.google/blog/gemini-robotics-2-brings-whole-body-intelligence-to-robots/).

The new model will allow humanoid robots to perform a wider range of actions, as it allows them to walk, crouch, stretch, and manipulate objects. Videos shared by Google show how Apptronik's Apollo 2 robot can [bend over to pick up](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nBftSI5mmHA) a watering can, as well as find and take specific items off a shelf.

Though Google DeepMind not …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/973276/google-deepmind-gemini-robotics-2-whole-body)

title: (No AI) Friend re-launches its AI pendant with a speaker that talks to you, for twice the price
author: David Imel
content:
![A mock-up of the Friend pendant. It’s a small white puck on a necklace.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/chorus/uploads/chorus_asset/file/25777487/millennial_explorer_a_comp_v004.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Do you remember Friend? The Friend that launched an AI pendant, spent $1.8 million of its $2.5 million to acquire friend.com, and plastered the NYC subway with ads promoting artificial companionship?

Yeah well, if you didn't remember, [Friend is back](https://x.com/AviSchiffmann/status/2082827785987629526). And now, it's twice the price.

> Introducing friend. [pic.twitter.com/T5vUCj7iqv](https://t.co/T5vUCj7iqv)
> 
> \- friend (@friend) [July 30, 2026](https://x.com/friend/status/2082827641338658873?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)

This morning, Friend [launched a new ad](https://x.com/friend/status/2082827641338658873?s=20) showing two people talking to their Friend pendants about very personal life problems. It didn't say it explicitly, but the ad showcased a new feature the pendant now includes: a speaker. Before, Friend would only message back to you, but now, …
